descriptionMarkdown:
Make most anything.

Except pipes, stone bricks, concrete and reinforced concrete, you must supply these ingredients in the same way as real intermediaries.

The ship also doesn't make blue belts, but seeing as you can't make turbo belts in space just make all of those in Vulcanus.

Reaches 1200 km/s. It is possible to strip more platform to make it slightly faster. Stripping rows of bays gives even more speed.
title: Universal Constructor Mk1
